body:
Doctool does not support conditional settings. If the codebase is compiled without C#, running doctool will delete your new settings descriptions which is an issue.
Settings currently have to exist for all configurations, or be dynamic and without documentation.
This is why we can't exclude GDScript or 3D only settings too.

I didn't consider that, thanks for lmk.

Let me know which you think is appropriate:

- **Keep #ifdef, remove docs:** Settings only exist with mono, undocumented but functional
- **Remove #ifdef, keep docs:** Settings always exist (even without mono), docs stay intact

I'm leaning toward the latter since users without mono likely won't look at the dotnet section anyway, and it keeps things consistent with how other module settings handle this limitation. Happy to go either direction though!
